newsitem.title: UK: North Sea Captain field to start late Dec - Texaco.
newsitem.headline: North Sea Captain field to start late Dec - Texaco.

text.p: Texaco Inc said on Monday first oil from its Captain field in the central North Sea would flow in late December.

Captain, in block 13/22a some 90 miles northeast of Aberdeen, will pump oil via a floating production, storage and off-loading vessel (FPSO) which sailed from the Astano shipyard in northwest Spain on Saturday.
After final fitting at the nearby Bazan naval yard, the FPSO will sail for the North Sea and is due to arrive at the field on December 1, Texaco said.
Hook-up is expected to take two to three weeks.
Captain should eventually reach peak production of about 60,000 barrels per day, which will be exported via tankers.
